items.passage: Last summer, my family took a trip to Taitung. We arrived by train and stayed at a small hotel near the beach. Every morning, I explored the mountains and took many photos. We ate local food and bought some gifts for our friends. Next year, we are going to travel abroad for the first time. I can't wait to visit a new country.
